job.title: CRM & Marketing Specialist (Klaviyo)
job.description:
The opportunity
 
Our client is an iconic Australian luxury fashion house with a loyal, global community, selling through its own online storefronts, boutiques and wholesale partners. They're moving from calendar-led broadcasting to communications shaped by what each customer actually wants, and this role sits at the centre of that shift.
 
As the day-to-day owner of Klaviyo, you'll build, fix and scale the automated email and SMS journeys that turn first-time buyers into repeat customers and bring lapsed customers back, working closely with the data, ecommerce, retail and clienteling teams.
 
What you'll do
  • Own and optimise core flows: welcome, browse and cart abandon, back-in-stock, post-purchase, win-back and VIP
  • Design journeys for the moments that matter most, especially converting first-time buyers into second purchases
  • Build cross-flow logic properly, including frequency caps, suppression rules and exit/re-entry conditions
  • Create behavioural segments and use dynamic content and product feeds so every send feels personal
  • Run a structured testing programme across subject lines, creative, timing, offers and journeys
  • Report on revenue, conversion, repeat purchase rate and retention, not just opens and clicks
  • Own QA and compliance (Spam Act, Privacy Act and international equivalents), and keep the account healthy with clean data and documented logic
  • Keep every email and SMS unmistakably on-brand, from tone to design
About you
  • 5+ years in email, CRM, lifecycle or marketing automation, ideally in fashion, luxury, beauty or DTC ecommerce
  • Deep, hands-on Klaviyo experience, including complex flows, segments and dynamic content (essential)
  • Experience connecting Shopify and retail data into an ESP
  • A track record of lifting retention, repeat purchase or lifetime value
  • Analytical confidence and the ability to turn data into action
  • A genuine eye for design and brand, and an understanding of why tone matters in luxury
  • Meticulous attention to detail, with the ability to juggle multiple journeys at once
  • Nice to have: CDP, clienteling or omnichannel retail data experience, multi-market programmes, basic HTML/CSS, SQL

job.title: Production Manager
job.description:
About the opportunity

Our client is a well-established, family-owned Australian fresh produce business with more than 50 years of experience and four generations of hands-on expertise. They grow quality product on trusted NSW farms and supply it through to major supermarkets, and they take real pride in continuous improvement.

They're now looking for an experienced Production Manager to step in for an initial 8-week engagement, keep operations running smoothly and make an immediate impact. For the right person, this is a genuine opportunity to move into a permanent role.

The role
  • Lead and coordinate daily production, packing and dispatch operations
  • Manage, motivate and roster production teams to meet volume and quality targets
  • Plan production schedules to meet customer and retail supply demands
  • Drive a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with WHS and food safety standards
  • Monitor KPIs including yield, wastage, efficiency and labour cost, and act on what the numbers tell you
  • Identify and implement practical process improvements
  • Work closely with the growing, quality, logistics and commercial teams
About you
  • Proven experience as a Production Manager or Operations Manager in food manufacturing, fresh produce, agriculture or a similar fast-paced FMCG environment
  • Strong people leadership, with the ability to earn the respect of a hands-on, shop-floor team
  • Working knowledge of food safety and quality systems (HACCP, SQF or equivalent)
  • Comfortable making decisions quickly and getting stuck in when needed
  • Commercially minded, with a good eye for efficiency and continuous improvement
  • Available to start immediately, or on short notice
  • Right to work in Australia

job.title: Technical Business Analyst (AI-Enabled)
job.description:
About The Company
 
Our client is a high growth, private equity backed business operating in the renewable energy storage sector, one of the most active and important spaces in the current energy transition. Growth has been rapid, and the commercial side of the business is performing well.
 
This is a business that genuinely embraces modern tools, including AI-assisted development, and expects its people to work the same way.
 
About The Role
 
This is a hands-on Technical Business Analyst role for someone who wants to fix problems, not just document them. You'll work across sales, operations, installers and finance to map workflows end to end, identify where processes break down, and then build the solution yourself using AI coding tools like Claude Code and Cursor to turn findings into working systems rather than static requirements documents.
 
Key responsibilities include:
  • Mapping and improving cross-functional workflows, identifying manual steps, double handling and data gaps
  • Owning the data layer, writing and optimising SQL in BigQuery, modelling data from source systems, reconciling records, and building reporting/dashboards
  • Specifying and building integrations between platforms such as Cin7, HubSpot and other operational systems (API mapping, data rules, error handling, monitoring)
  • Automating repetitive work through scheduled jobs, triggered workflows or AI agents
  • Building and extending React front ends for internal tools (CRM views, scheduling, installer workflows, ticketing)
  • Running delivery, writing PRDs, prioritising the backlog, running UAT, and taking changes through to go-live
  • Keeping data definitions, integration specs and process maps current
About You
  • 5+ years' experience as a technical BA, systems analyst or product analyst in a delivery-heavy environment
  • Strong SQL skills, ideally with BigQuery or another cloud data warehouse (joins, CTEs, window functions, data quality checks)
  • Integration experience with REST APIs, webhooks and JSON, and hands-on exposure to platforms like HubSpot, Cin7, Unleashed or Xero
  • Comfortable reading, editing and shipping React/JavaScript/TypeScript front-end code, with AI tools accelerating the work
  • Genuine, demonstrable experience with AI-assisted coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar),  you know how to review and test the output, not just accept it
  • A process-improvement mindset and the confidence to work directly with frontline teams to turn messy workflows into clear future states
  • A bias toward shipping working fixes over handing over specs
  • Python for scripting and data pipelines
  • Exposure to MCP, LLM agents or workflow tools such as n8n, Make or Zapier
  • Google Cloud experience beyond BigQuery (e.g. Cloud Functions, Scheduler)

job.title: Customer Service Consultant - Sydney CBD | Sponsorship Available
job.description:
About the Company 

Join one of Australia's most exciting start-ups as they reshape personal lending with empathy, speed and a customer-first mindset. Backed by rapid growth and purpose, they've significantly grown the past few years. 

We're on the lookout for full-time Customer Service Consultants to join the team in their Sydney CBD office. This is more than a job - it's a chance to make a real difference to everyday Australians who need support navigating life's trickier moments.

What you'll be doing:
  • Handle inbound customer enquiries via phone and email
  • Help customers through their loan application journey with care and clarity
  • Work cross-functionally with internal teams to progress applications
  • Provide timely updates and solve problems with a sense of urgency
  • Bring empathy, warmth and active listening to every interaction
  • Keep things moving - follow up with clients and partners to stay on track
What we're looking for:
  • Clear, confident communicator with outstanding listening skills
  • Empathetic and solutions-focused - you genuinely care about helping people
  • Resilient and adaptable in a high-volume, fast-paced environment
  • Tech-savvy, accurate and confident juggling multiple systems
  • Contact centre experience is a big plus, but not essential
  • Full working rights or on a Working Holiday Visa? No worries - you're welcome to apply
  • Sponsorship is available for the right candidates
What's in it for you:
  • Full-time, Sydney CBD office-based role (no remote)
  • Career growth and learning opportunities in a booming sector
  • Competitive salary 
  • Five weeks annual leave
  • Be part of a business that's genuinely making lives better

job.title: Head of Finance
job.description:
About The Company 
 
Our client is a fast growing, Australian brand with a genuine global footprint. With Australia representing around a third of the business and the remainder spread across international markets, this is a company that manufactures its own products, sells predominantly through wholesale channels, and continues to expand into new territories. Backed by venture capital, the business is in a genuine growth and change phase, and this is your opportunity to be a key part of that next stage.
 
We are seeking an experienced, hands on Head of Finance to lead the finance function and play a central role in the commercial direction of the business. 
 
About The Role 
 
You will lead a small, highly experienced finance team, take ownership of all financial reporting and analysis, and act as a genuine business partner to the leadership team on the big picture decisions shaping the company's growth. 
 
Key responsibilities include:
  • Preparing and presenting monthly board reporting to VC and investor stakeholders
  • Consolidating financial reporting across multiple business entities
  • Overseeing costing and product costing, including raw materials, cost of goods and inventory holding
  • Deliver budgeting, forecasting, reporting and commercial analysis
  • Managing multi-currency, multi-customer forecasting across a largely international customer base
  • Utilising AI tools and platforms to enhance forecasting, stock planning and reporting efficiency
  • Drive improvements across processes, controls, reporting and automation
  • Providing commercial support on supplier negotiations, capital investment and growth initiatives
About You
 
To succeed in this role you will bring proven, hands on experience in a similar consumer goods environment, ideally retail, beauty, fashion or a closely aligned industry.
  • CA/CPA qualified 
  • Prior experience in a Head of Finance, or similar senior finance role within a consumer goods, retail, beauty, fashion or manufacturing business
  • Demonstrated experience preparing and presenting board reports, ideally gained within a VC backed, private equity backed, or listed business environment
  • Strong technical accounting and reporting skills, with the ability to consolidate reporting across multiple entities
  • Direct experience with inventory builds, product costing, bills of materials and manufacturing cost structures
  • High AI literacy and comfort adopting new technology and reporting tools
  • Excellent communication skills, with the confidence to engage in commercial discussions with international investors and stakeholders
  • The maturity and commercial acumen to operate at a senior level, balancing detail with big picture thinking
Key Benefits: 
  • This is a rare opportunity to join a genuinely exciting, homegrown Australian brand at an important stage of its growth.
  • You will work closely with an engaged and commercially minded leadership team
  • Be part of a company that is building something significant on the global stage
  • Hybrid working 
  • Attractive Salary Package + Bonus

job.title: Wholesale Sales & Account Manager
job.description:
About The Company 
This is a globally recognised lifestyle and apparel brand with a loyal following that extends well beyond Australia. Built on genuine creativity and a strong sense of identity, the brand has grown from a niche label into an internationally established name, with a product range spanning apparel, accessories and lifestyle collaborations that consistently resonate with its market.

The Australian headquarters, based in Sydney, drives wholesale and retail strategy across the ANZ region. It's a business that values authenticity over manufactured hype, people here are expected to bring genuine enthusiasm, keep things simple, and treat everyone, from buyers to teammates, with inclusivity and respect. Think fast-moving and culture-first, but commercially sharp.

This is a rare chance to join a brand with real market recognition and creative credibility, in a role where your commercial results are seen and valued at the top.


About The Role
This isn't a "manage the spreadsheet and wait for orders" wholesale role. This is a genuine seat at the table with a globally recognised, values-led lifestyle brand and full ownership of a wholesale portfolio across Australia and New Zealand.

You'll run the entire sales cycle end-to-end: sell-in, delivery, in-season trading, reorders, AR, the lot. You'll hunt new business in the independent retail channel. You'll get direct airtime with the CEO. And you'll be backed by a brand built on authenticity, enthusiasm, inclusiveness and simplicity, not corporate box-ticking.

If you're a wholesale sales professional who wants real commercial ownership, not just a territory to babysit, keep reading.

What You'll Actually Be Doing:

Sell. Close. Repeat.
  • Run seasonal sell-in presentations, order capture, High-Low analysis and PO confirmation like a pro
  • Own the full pipeline, lead generation through to signed deal, no hand-holding required
  • Chase and land new accounts across the independent retail channel, this is your growth engine
Own the Accounts, Grow the Revenue
  • Be the trusted go-to for key and mid-tier wholesale accounts
  • Plan and execute monthly sell-through activity that actually moves inventory
  • Walk into buyer meetings and sell the brand, the product, and the supply chain story with confidence
Master the Numbers
  • Take full ownership of AR, collections, ageing reports, payment negotiations, the works
  • Spot risk before it becomes a problem: excess stock, slowing sales, late payments
  • Build response strategies, present them to leadership, and own the outcome
  • Report performance and risk straight to the CEO, your insights drive real decisions
Make Noise
  • Plan and run seasonal campaigns and product launches that get buyers talking
  • Manage partner SMU projects and collaborative marketing activity that drives sell-through
Be the Commercial Engine Room
  • Support pricing (RRP/FOB) and margin monitoring
  • Run the show across NetSuite, NuORDER and Brandscope, catalogue, orders, invoicing, all of it
  • Feed market intel back to Merchandising and Design so the product keeps hitting the mark
About You 
  • 4-6 years in wholesale or B2B sales, you know the game and you play it well; retail apparel
  • A track record of hunting and closing new business, not just servicing what's already there
  • Full-cycle wholesale experience: sell-in, delivery, in-season, reorders,  you've done it all before
  • Real AR and collections chops, and you're comfortable being the bridge to Finance
  • Sharp, data-driven instincts — advanced Excel is second nature
  • ERP/NuORDER/Brandscope experience, big plus
  • Deep knowledge of the Australian wholesale market
  • Apparel or lifestyle brand background, highly valued
  • An existing buyer network in fashion/lifestyle, this will fast-track your success
  • Valid driver's licence and willingness to travel as required
What's In It For You
  • Attractive salary package + genuine performance incentive
  • Direct exposure to the CEO and senior leadership, your work won't get lost in a hierarchy
  • A brand with real cultural cachet and a values-first way of doing business
  • Full ownership of a growing AU/NZ territory, this is your book to build

job.title: Quality Assurance Manager
job.description:
About the Company
Our client is a well established and rapidly growing Australian food manufacturing business supplying fresh products to major national supermarket retailers. With a strong reputation for quality, food safety and operational excellence, the business operates at significant scale and continues to invest in its people, systems and production capability.

The organisation is privately owned, values driven and built on a long standing heritage within the Australian fresh food sector. With growth accelerating and retailer demand increasing, the company is seeking an experienced Quality Assurance Manager to lead food safety, compliance and quality performance across the site.

This is a highly visible leadership role with direct exposure to senior leadership and genuine influence on how quality and food safety are embedded across the business.

About the Role

As Quality Assurance Manager you will take full ownership of the food safety and quality management systems for a large scale fresh food manufacturing facility.

Reporting directly to the senior leadership team, you will be responsible for maintaining best practice standards, managing retailer relationships and leading the QA function to ensure the business consistently exceeds regulatory and supermarket requirements.

Key responsibilities include
  • Ownership and continuous improvement of HACCP, food safety and quality management systems aligned with FSANZ and major retailer standards
  • Leading pathogen management and environmental monitoring programs including Listeria control and response protocols
  • Acting as the primary QA contact for major supermarket customers and managing retailer compliance requirements
  • Preparing for and leading all internal and external audits including supermarket supplier audits
  • Managing customer complaints, non conformances and root cause investigations
  • Leading and developing the QA team while embedding a strong food safety culture across operations
  • Partnering with operations and commercial teams to balance quality requirements with operational performance
  • Managing supplier quality standards and raw material specifications
  • Ensuring product specifications, labelling and compliance documentation remain current and audit ready
  • Providing clear reporting on quality metrics, incidents and improvement initiatives

About You

You are an experienced QA leader who thrives in fast paced food manufacturing environments and understands the expectations of major Australian retailers.
You bring strong technical capability in food safety along with the leadership skills required to influence teams and maintain rigorous standards across the business.

Key experience includes
  • 5 plus years experience in a senior quality assurance or food safety role within food manufacturing
  • Deep understanding of HACCP and food safety frameworks in Australia
  • Strong experience managing supermarket retailer requirements such as Woolworths, Coles or ALDI
  • Hands on experience managing pathogen monitoring and environmental testing programs
  • Experience leading retailer and certification audits
  • Tertiary qualification in Food Science, Food Technology, Microbiology or a related discipline
  • HACCP certification and exposure to recognised standards such as SQF, BRC or HARPS
  • Strong leadership capability with experience developing QA teams and influencing operational staff
Experience within fresh food, chilled food or high risk food environments will be highly regarded.

Key Benefits
  • Senior leadership role with genuine influence across the business
  • Direct exposure to executive leadership and strategic decision making
  • Stable and growing food manufacturing organisation
  • Opportunity to lead and shape food safety culture across the site
  • Competitive salary package based on experience
  • Long term career opportunity within a respected Australian business

job.title: Customer Service Specialist
job.description:
About the Company

Our client is a national leader in commercial services. With a strong national footprint and a genuine focus on developing internal talent, they're growing their commercial team and looking for someone ready to build a long-term career in customer service & account management.


About the Role

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with a background in sales administration or customer service who is looking to fast-track their career toward a Account Manager role. You'll be the primary point of contact for a portfolio of national and cross-regional clients, working closely with National Account Managers to keep service, pricing and communication running smoothly.

Day to day, you'll:
  • Build strong relationships with key customer stakeholders and manage regular contact cycles
  • Resolve customer queries on pricing, service, accounts and invoicing
  • Maintain accurate customer data and documentation across internal systems
  • Coordinate service delivery with branch operations and support teams
  • Support renewals, contract variations and quotes alongside National Account Managers
  • Produce weekly and monthly reporting on customer service activity and performance
This role has been specifically designed as a stepping stone into account management — genuine progression is on the table for the right person.

About You
  • You aspire to grow into an Account Manager role and want to be backed to get there
  • Strong communicator, confident building relationships with internal and external stakeholders
  • Excellent attention to detail and administrative accuracy
  • Strong Excel skills
  • Prior experience in sales administration, customer service or a coordination role
  • Comfortable managing competing priorities in a fast-paced commercial environment
If you're looking for a genuine career pathway into account management, backed by a supportive national business, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Benefits
  • Attractive Salary Package 
  • Car parking provided
  • Strong mentorship from an experienced Leaders
  • Clear pathway into Key Account Management
  • Collaborative national business with strong internal support

job.title: Digital Marketing Manager
job.description:
About the Company
 
They are fast-scaling, PE-backed business operating in the property and travel technology space, managing a large national portfolio built through a series of acquisitions. Right now, that portfolio runs across fragmented systems inherited through M&A, before they can execute an effective national marketing strategy, we need to build the foundation underneath it.
 
The marketing function is entering an exciting build phase and they're looking for a Digital Marketing Manager to help lead the charge.
 
About the Role
 
This is a genuine build-phase seat, not a pure campaign execution role. Your first 6-12 months will be spent laying the groundwork, domain migration, website rebuild, and building out the data and CRM infrastructure that the business needs before it can market effectively. Once that foundation is in place, you'll move into owning national and local campaign execution across multiple audiences.
 
You won't be doing the technical build yourself, you will work closely with the technology team, but you'll be the digital marketing voice in the room, shaping what "good" looks like, choosing the right tools, and making sure the foundation is built with commercial marketing outcomes in mind.
 
What You'll Be Doing
 
  • Support the migration from a legacy domain to a new national domain, working closely with the technical team to protect SEO equity through the transition
  • Play a key role in the website rebuild project, site architecture, and platform decisions
  • Help stand up a proper CRM and centralised data layer, the business currently has no single source of truth for its customer database, so this is genuinely ground-up work
  • Working with the internal insights team to connect valuable portfolio-level data back to customers in a meaningful way
  • Have a seat at the table on martech tool selection (CRM platform, marketing automation, etc.) — you don't need to build it, but you need to know what "good" looks like
  • Own execution of national marketing campaigns across performance channels (paid social, search, programmatic)
  • Run local/regional campaigns tailored to different markets, this is a business with genuine geographic nuance, where messaging that works in one state may be completely wrong in another
 
About You
  • Solid experience in a digital marketing management role, ideally gained in a scale-up, startup, or high-growth environment, comfort with ambiguity and a "build it as we go" mindset is essential
  • Exposure to CRM platforms (HubSpot or similar) and an understanding of what a modern martech stack should look like, even if you haven't built one yourself
  • SEO fundamentals, particularly around site migrations and protecting search equity through a domain or platform change
  • A commercially minded approach, able to think about lead generation and audience segmentation, not just channel execution
  • Comfort operating semi-autonomously in a hybrid/remote team, this isn't a role for someone who needs to be managed closely
  • Franchising, multi-site, or portfolio-based business experience is a genuine plus
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
